reason: Clipboard import preserves authored content, inline identity and active text marks while distinguishing visible HTML from literal text and native plain-paste intent.

identity.overdeepMetadata: Keep readable clipboard text without importing an unsafe atom; incompatible saved documents use their separate text fallback.
identity.malformedRetainedQuotes: Restore full quote text before mutating tray membership; ordinary and message-edit submissions retain that recovered text and neighboring identities.
identity.programmaticReplacement: An existing quote outside a replacement retains its occurrence and cannot be cloned into inserted prose by a stale external offset.

fileDrop.classification: Use each file item's directory entry; a directory name must not exclude unrelated files.
fileDrop.itemFallback: Use nonempty FileList entries when no file items are exposed.
fileDrop.nativeDirectories: Attach disk-backed directories as exact local path references with a trailing slash; never upload their bytes or infer image delivery from their name.
fileDrop.directoryRecovery: Preserve directory identity through send, saved history, Edit and queue recovery; open directory cards with the system reveal action.

composition.uncommittedInput: Keep the candidate in the editor without committing the ordinary chat draft.
composition.commit: Notify the owning input after final browser composition records settle, even if the final candidate text did not change.
composition.replacedDocument: Reject a deferred completion notification from a retired document generation.
composition.keys: The active input method owns composing Enter and Escape; no general post-commit cooldown is added.
